spans.text: It's kind of cute and very loyal, and it has savage fighting power...

units.displayText: Upon hearing Persicaria's words, an idea suddenly forms in my head.

spans.text: Upon hearing Persicaria's words, an idea suddenly forms in my head.

units.rawText: That's it! Didn't Chanzhi say that plushie would make it so that nobody around it could lie?

spans.text: That's it! Didn't Chanzhi say that plushie would make it so that nobody around it could lie?

units.rawText: It all makes sense now!
units.displayText: It all makes sense now!

spans.text: It all makes sense now!

units.rawText: By which you mean...
units.displayText: By which you mean...

spans.text: By which you mean...

units.rawText: After that plushie went berserk, it read the neural clouds of all the Dolls within its effect radius.
units.displayText: After that plushie went berserk, it read the neural clouds of all the Dolls within its effect radius.

spans.text: After that plushie went berserk, it read the neural clouds of all the Dolls within its effect radius.

units.rawText: It used that data to create duplicates of everyone that expressed their inner selves. This way, everyone is unable to lie!
units.displayText: It used that data to create duplicates of everyone that expressed their inner selves. This way, everyone is unable to lie!

spans.text: It used that data to create duplicates of everyone that expressed their inner selves. This way, everyone is unable to lie!

spans.text: But... But is it even possible to read base layer neural cloud data without establishing an interface?

units.displayText: Ah, if it isn't the Professor!

spans.text: Ah, if it isn't the Professor!

units.displayText: Kuro looks at me and then sidles up while rubbing her hands.

spans.text: Kuro looks at me and then sidles up while rubbing her hands.

units.rawText: Say, Prof, haven't there been nonstop reports of unidentified creatures in the Oasis today?
units.displayText: Say, Prof, haven't there been nonstop reports of unidentified creatures in the Oasis today?

spans.text: Say, Prof, haven't there been nonstop reports of unidentified creatures in the Oasis today?

spans.text: The agents who don't know what's going on must be terribly worried... We need to stream the conditions on the ground to reassure them, don't you think?

spans.text: Which is why you need to unblock my stream channel...

units.displayText: Hey!

spans.text: Um, ah, Professor, it's just running its mouth, it has nothing to do with me...

units.rawText: Looks like these chibis aren't completely useless after all.
units.displayText: Looks like these chibis aren't completely useless after all.

spans.text: Looks like these chibis aren't completely useless after all.

spans.text: Don't talk like it doesn't concern you, Professor! Hurry up and stop them!
